topic: Calling the Insurance Line to Check if a Clinic Is In-Network

script.title: THE IN-NETWORK CHECK
script.scene_zh: 保險熱線 · 網內查證
script.story_hook: One clinic name, two doors, one careful call.
script.intro_zh: 同名的診所兩個地址，一通電話問出其中的門道。
script.welcome_en: Hi, we're calling the insurance line today. Listen for plan words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景在保險客服專線。留意方案相關的說法。
script.outro: And the answer was clear. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 答案終於清楚了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: you made an old man very happy
script.char_a_description: a soft-spoken retiree in his early seventies with thinning snow-white hair slicked back, bushy white eyebrows, a maroon zip-up fleece over a pale blue collared shirt, and slightly stooped shoulders
script.char_b_description: a bright woman in her early thirties with copper-brown hair in two long braids tucked behind her shoulders, a forest green service polo, a slim headset over one ear, and an easy smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, is this the member services line?
dialogue.phonetic: /həˈloʊ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈmɛmbɚ ˈsɝvəsz laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你好，這裡是會員服務專線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! Who am I speaking with today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz hu æm aɪ ˈspikɪŋ wɪð təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是的！請問我該稱呼您什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is Arthur Penn, calling about a clinic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ˈɑɹθɚ pɛn ˈkɔlɪŋ əˈbaʊt ə ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我是亞瑟·潘，想確認一間診所。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Mr. Penn. What's the question?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mi tu ˈmɪstɚ pɛn wɑts ðə ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識您，潘先生。請問想問的是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my knees. I found the Bayview Clinic.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl maɪ niz aɪ faʊnd ðə ˈbeɪˌvju ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 是我的膝蓋問題。我瞧見一家灣景診所。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice to ask about. Is it in town?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tʃɔɪz tə æsk əˈbaʊt ɪz ɪt ɪn taʊn/
dialogue.zh: 問這個就對了。它在市區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, that's the thing. There are two of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðæts ðə ˈθɪŋ ðɛɹ ɑɹ ˈtu ʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 呃，問題就在這裡。同名的竟然有兩間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, same name, different doors, classic.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ seɪm neɪm ˈdɪfɹənt dɔɹz ˈklæsɪk/
dialogue.zh: 哈，一樣的名號、不同的門牌，太經典了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. So which one is in-network for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ wɪtʃ wʌn ɪz ˈɪnˌnɛtˌwɝk fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。所以哪一間才在我的網內？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can check! May I get your member ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn tʃɛk meɪ aɪ ɡɛt jɔɹ ˈmɛmbɚ aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 我可以查！能先告訴我您的會員編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, it's P-E-N, then four-two-seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪts ˈpi ˈi ˈɛn ðɛn fɔɹ tu ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 當然，是 P-E-N，然後 427。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, thank you. And your date of birth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɑɾ ɪt ˈθæŋk ju ænd jɔɹ ˈdeɪt əv ˈbɝθ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，感謝。再請提供您的出生年月日？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: March sixth, nineteen fifty-five.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑɹθ sɪks ˈnaɪnˈtin ˈfɪfti faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 三月六日，一九五五年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I see plan code Delta plus.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ si plæn koʊd ˈdɛltə plʌz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我看到您的方案代碼是 Delta plus。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delta plus, yes. Is that the important part?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɛltə plʌz jɛz ɪz ðæt ði ɪmˈpɔɹtənt pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 對。那個代碼很重要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It decides your rules, so kind of, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪˈsaɪdz jɔɹ ɹulz soʊ kaɪnd əv jɛz/
dialogue.zh: 它決定適用的規則，所以某種程度上，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, so I have both addresses. Start with Fifth Street?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ soʊ aɪ hæv boʊθ ədˈɹɛsəz stɑɹt wɪð faɪf striːt/
dialogue.zh: 好，我兩間地址都有。請先查五街那間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm... Fifth Street is in-network, confirmed.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm faɪf stɹit ɪz ˈɪnˌnɛtˌwɝk kənˈfɝmd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……五街那間是網內，確認無誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, good news travels fast these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd nuz ˈtɹævəlz fæst ðiz deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這年頭，好消息傳得就是快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not so fast! The other one's out-of-network.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt soʊ fæst ði ˈʌðɚ wʌnz ˈaʊt əv ˈnɛtˌwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 先別高興！另一間可是網外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the one near my bridge club?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪt ðə wʌn nɪɹ maɪ ˈbɹɪdʒ ˈklʌb/
dialogue.zh: 等等，就是我牌友會附近的那間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one. Forty percent more out there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə wʌn ˈfɔɹti pɚˈsɛnt mɔɹ ˈaʊt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 就是那間。網外要多付四成的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I've used that clinic for years, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪv ˈjuzd ðæt ˈklɪnɪk fɚ jɪrz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 唉，我在那裡看了好幾年病了，你知道嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I believe you. Old habits cost extra here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliv ju oʊld ˈhæbəts kɔst ˈɛkstɹə hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我相信您。只是舊習慣在保險裡是要多花錢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. Could a doctor's referral change that?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm kʊd ə ˈdɑktɚz ˌɹɛfəˈɹəl tʃeɪndʒ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯。醫生開的轉診單能改變這情況嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On Delta plus? No referrals needed at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈdɛltə plʌz noʊ ˌɹɛfəˈɹəlz ˈnidɪd æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 用 Delta plus 的話？完全不需要轉診單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, that's one less phone call.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈnaɪs ðæts wʌn ˈlɛs ˈfoʊn ˈkɔl/
dialogue.zh: 噢真好，那就少打一通電話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But if you want the other clinic, um...
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ɪf ju wɑnt ði ˈʌðɚ ˈklɪnɪk ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 但要是您堅持去另一間，嗯……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'd need special permission, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪd nid ˈspɛʃəl pɚˈmɪʃən ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就得先申請特別核准，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a network exception request. Takes weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛz ə ˈnɛtˌwɝk ɪkˈsɛpʃən rɪˈkwɛst teɪks wiks/
dialogue.zh: 對，網路豁免申請。起碼要好幾週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weeks. My knees move slower than that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiks maɪ niz muv ˈsloʊɚ ðæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 好幾週啊。我的膝蓋可等不了那麼久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. Fifth Street it is, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu faɪf stɹit ɪt ɪz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 確實。所以答案就是五街那間啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Agreed. One more thing: my sister visits me.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ maɪ ˈsɪstɚ ˈvɪzɪts mi/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣定。還有一件事：我姊姊要來小住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, what about her? She has our plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wət əˈbaʊt hɚ ʃi hæz aʊɹ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 好，關於她呢？她也參加我們的保險嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, she lives out of area, two states over.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃi lɪvz aʊt əv ˈɛɹiə tu steɪts ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不，她住在區外，隔了兩個州呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out-of-area? That's a different set of rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊt əv ˈɛɹiə ðæts ə ˈdɪfɹənt sɛt əv ɹulz/
dialogue.zh: 區外？那就是一套完全不同的規則了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and she worries about me, bless her.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛz ænd ʃi ˈwɝɪz əˈbaʊt mi blɛs hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，她總是替我操心，真是難為她了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet of her. Is she covered when visiting?
dialogue.phonetic: /swit əv hɚ ɪz ʃi ˈkʌvɚd wɛn ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 她真有心。那她來小住的時候，看病有保嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's what I hoped. Is that a thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wət aɪ ˈhoʊpt ɪz ðæt ə θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我就是這麼希望的。這規定真的存在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can be! Emergency care covers anyone, mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn bi ɪˈmɚdʒənsi kɛɹ ˈkʌvɚz ˈɛniˌwʌn ˈmoʊstli/
dialogue.zh: 可以的！緊急醫療幾乎人人都保得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And normal visits, like checkups for her?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈnɔɹməl ˈvɪzɪts laɪk ˈtʃɛkˌʌps fɚ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那一般門診呢？例如她順便做個健檢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if a clinic here is in her plan's network.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ə ˈklɪnɪk hɪɹ ɪz ɪn ɚ plænz ˈnɛtˌwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 只有這裡的診所也在她的保險網內才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How would we even find that out?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wʊd wi ˈivən faɪnd ðæt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們上哪兒去查這件事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send the search link by text today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ðə sɝtʃ lɪŋk baɪ tɛkst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天就用簡訊把查詢連結發過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text is perfect, email confuses me still.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ɪz ˈpɝfɪkt ˈimeɪl kənˈfjuz mi stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 簡訊最好了，郵件到現在還讓我頭疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, mine too sometimes. I'll do that, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn tu ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz aɪl du ðæt sɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我有時也一樣。我這就辦，先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. So Fifth Street, no referral, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ faɪf stɹit noʊ ˌɹɛfəˈɹəl jɛz/
dialogue.zh: 感謝。所以是五街那間、免轉診單，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred percent, in-network as we speak.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈhʌndɹəd pɚˈsɛnt ˈɪnˌnɛtˌwɝk əz wi spik/
dialogue.zh: 百分之百，此刻它就是網內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I still feel unsure next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ stɪl fil ʌnˈʃɝ nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 要是下週我又拿不準了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call back, quote this reference: K-Two-Six-Four.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl bæk kwaʊt ðɪs ˈɛfɚəns keɪ tu sɪks fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 再打來，報這個參考碼：K 二六四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: K two six four. Saved it, large font.
dialogue.phonetic: /keɪ tu sɪks ˈfɔɹ ˈseɪvd ɪt ˈlɑɹdʒ ˈfɑnt/
dialogue.zh: K 二六四。存好了，字體調到最大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're all set. Anything else, Mr. Penn?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ɔl sɛt ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls ˈmɪstɚ pɛn/
dialogue.zh: 都辦妥了。還想問什麼嗎，潘先生？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope. You made an old man very happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /nop ju meɪd ən oʊld mæn ˈvɛɹi ˈhæpi/
dialogue.zh: 沒了。你讓一個老先生開心極了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the job! Bridge club sounds fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈdʒɑb ˈbɹɪdʒ ˈklʌb ˈsaʊndz fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 應該的嘛！您的牌友會聽起來很有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is. Thursday pancakes, never missed one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈpænˌkɛks ˈnɛvɚ mɪst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 是啊。週四松餅聚會，多年來從未缺席。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delicious insurance policy, honestly. Take care now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈlɪʃəs ɪnˈʃɚəns ˈpɑləsi ˈɑnəstli teɪk kɛɹ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那可才是最甜的保險呢。您多保重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Almost forgot, what's your name, miss?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɔlˈmoʊst fɚˈɡɑt wɑts jɔɹ neɪm mɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈！差點忘了，對了小姐，您貴姓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rosa! Ask for Rosa next time, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹoʊzə æsk fɚ ˈɹoʊzə nɛkst taɪm hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 我姓羅莎！下次來請指名找我，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rosa. Thank you, Rosa, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹoʊzə θæŋk ju ˈɹoʊzə ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 羅莎。真心感謝你，羅莎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, Mr. Penn. Mind those knees, see you around.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈmɪstɚ pɛn maɪnd ðoʊz niz si ju əˈɹaʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 再見潘先生，照顧好膝蓋，我們再會。

script.youtube_title: 【這間診所收不收🏥】「你讓一個老先生開心極了」🎧｜會員編號・網內網外一通聽懂📞｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Checking a Clinic Is In-Network
script.youtube_title_en: "You Made an Old Man Very Happy" — Checking if a Clinic Is In-Network
script.youtube_description:
「你讓一個老先生開心極了」——膝蓋該看診了，可同名的診所一家在網內、一家在網外，這通保險客服專線到底要怎麼問？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在保險公司的會員服務熱線上。

你會聽到：報出會員編號與出生日期；分辨兩間同名診所的地址；搞懂方案代碼、轉診單與網路豁免申請；還有替外地親眷詢問探親期間保障規則的禮貌問答。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人講保險時最真實的口語：um、well、so、oh、hmm。聽完你就會用：is this the member services line、in-network、out-of-area、quote this reference。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱頻道並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"You made an old man very happy" — one clinic name hides two addresses, and on this plan only one of them is in-network. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set entirely on a call to the insurance member services line.

You will hear: giving your member ID and birthday, telling two same-name clinics apart, learning that plan code Delta plus needs no referrals, and politely asking how an out-of-area sister is covered while visiting.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, oh, hmm. By the end you'll own phrases like Is this the member services line, in-network, out-of-area, and quote this reference.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
看診之前，那間診所到底在不在你的保險網內？為什麼同名的診所，一家便宜、一家要多付四成？遠道而來的親眷，看病又算哪一種規則？

這一集帶大家打完一通保險客服專線，從報會員編號、查同名診所、確認轉診規則，一路聽到替姊姊問清區外保障，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📞 開場確認：Hello, is this the member services line?
🏥 網內查證：Hmm... Fifth Street is in-network, confirmed.
🧭 區外規則：Out-of-area? That's a different set of rules.
🔖 收尾留念：Call back, quote this reference: K-Two-Six-Four.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通電話走一趟，下次撥給保險公司，你就能一句一句問到重點。

祝你看診順利，帳單溫柔。
